Frequently asked questions

Go to help center
Follow the steps below to check if your iOS device supports eSIM technology. Please remember that the steps may or may not apply to your device. The best way to confirm eSIM capability is still through your device manufacturer, vendor, or primary carrier.
In order to install your eSIM: – Your device needs to be eSIM compatible. – Your device needs to be network unlocked. – You need to have a good network/WiFi connection.
The eSIM data package expiration date depends on the eSIM validity and data consumption. Your eSIM data package will last for the presented validity period as long as you do not consume all data before then. The validity period starts when the eSIM activates.
In order to install your eSIM: – Your device needs to be eSIM compatible. Android devices that are eSIM compatible have an “Add Carrier” menu – Your device needs to be network unlocked – You need to have a good network/WiFi connection.
You can purchase an eSIM through Spotesim website (https://www.spotesim.com/) or in Spotesim app. Please see full details in the article.
